scenarios.b: Standard residential replacement. Most homes in Saugus, Lynn, and Revere run a 40 or 50-gallon atmospheric or power-vent tank. Shane installs both.
Necessary when there's no natural draft chimney or when an existing vent doesn't meet code. Power-vent units run quiet, vent through PVC, and last 8–12 years on average.

Endless hot water, smaller footprint, longer service life. Right answer for some homes — not all. We'll walk through whether your gas line, venting, and water hardness make tankless the better economic call.

scenarios.h: Leaking tank, no hot water, pilot won't light
scenarios.b: Diagnose first. If it's a thermocouple, control board, or element — repair. If the tank is rusted through, replacement is the only honest answer.

qa_title: Questions homeowners ask about water heaters

qa.q: Should I repair or replace my water heater?
qa.a: A tank that is leaking from the tank itself, or rusted through, can't be patched, so that is a replacement. Problems like a pilot that won't stay lit, a failed thermocouple, a bad control board or a burned-out element are often repairable, which is why the first step is a diagnosis. Age matters too: an older tank is more likely to fail again soon, and the data label on the unit usually shows the manufacture date or a serial number that encodes it. Send a photo of the unit and its data label with your request so the answer starts from the right equipment.

qa.q: What affects the cost of a water heater replacement?
list: The type and size you choose: a standard tank, a power-vent unit, or a tankless conversion.
Fuel: gas or electric, and whether you are keeping it or switching.
Venting: a power-vent or tankless unit may need different venting than the old one.
Where it sits: basement, closet or attic, and how easy it is to get the old unit out and the new one in.
Removal and disposal of the old unit, and any permit the job calls for.
qa.a: No price is listed here because it depends on those points. Ask Shane for a quote. The quickest way is to text photos.

qa.q: How long does a water heater replacement take?
qa.a: A straight swap of a common 40 or 50 gallon gas or electric tank is the quickest job; ask Shane how soon he can do yours. Anything that changes the setup, such as moving the heater, switching fuel or adding venting, takes longer.

qa.q: How often should a water heater be serviced?
qa.a: Follow the manufacturer's instructions for your model. Many call for periodic flushing to clear sediment from the tank. Popping or rumbling noises, rust-colored hot water, or moisture around the base of the tank are signs to have it looked at. If you are weighing a {{boiler-service|boiler with an indirect hot water tank}}, that is a different setup with its own service needs.

send_for_quote: Send with your request: a photo of the water heater and its data label, whether it runs on gas or electric, where it is in the house, and what it is doing (leaking, no hot water, pilot out).

h1: Boiler repair & replacement, Saugus to Boston
tagline: Service, repair and full replacements, with 24/7 emergency service when the heat goes out.
meta_desc: Boiler service, repair and replacement from Saugus to Boston. Multi-zone systems, combi units and indirect tanks. Licensed, owner-operated. Call 781-820-4592.
intro: Heat is not optional in January. Shane services and replaces high-efficiency boilers — cast iron and mod-con, multi-zone systems with indirect tanks, Combi units that handle heat and hot water on one box. When a boiler dies in a cold snap, call: emergency service is 24/7.

scenarios.b: Combustion analysis, electrode check, low-water cutoff test, fault code clearing. A clean boiler runs longer and uses less fuel. We tell you straight what's wear-and-tear vs. what's about to fail.
Pilot out, ignitor failed, circulator stuck, zone valve, aquastat, low water. Most fixes are same-visit.
Cast iron pull-and-swap, mod-con upgrade, Combi conversion. We size based on a Manual-J load, not the nameplate of the unit that died.
Paired with the boiler for unlimited hot water at high efficiency. Better than a standalone tank for most multi-bath homes.
New zone added for an addition or finished basement. Zone valve, thermostat, piping, controls — done right the first time.

guarantee: Master plumber installs (MA license 9630040-PL-M). Manufacturer warranties apply to the boilers we install — we go over the warranty and the workmanship in writing before the job.

qa.q: Should I repair or replace my boiler?
qa.a: Repair makes sense when one part has failed on a boiler that is otherwise sound: an ignitor, circulator, zone valve, aquastat or low-water cutoff, for example. Replacement is worth discussing when a boiler keeps breaking down, leaks at the boiler body, or is old enough that parts are hard to find. Older boilers also tend to burn more fuel than modern high-efficiency models. Send a photo of the boiler and its data label and describe the symptom or fault code so the quote starts from the right equipment.

qa.q: What is the difference between a cast iron, mod-con and combi boiler?
list: Cast iron: the traditional heavy-section boiler, common in older homes.
Mod-con (modulating condensing): adjusts its output to the demand and recovers extra heat from its exhaust, which needs a condensate drain and plastic venting.
Combi: heats the house and makes domestic hot water from one unit, with no separate tank.
Indirect tank: a separate insulated hot water tank heated by the boiler, so the boiler supplies the hot water too.
qa.a: Which one is right depends on your house, your fuel and your hot water use, so say what you have and what you want when you send your request.

qa.q: What affects the cost of a boiler replacement?
list: The boiler type and size, and whether you are keeping the same fuel.
Venting and chimney changes, which depend on the type of boiler.
How many heating zones you have, and the thermostats, valves and controls that go with them.
Whether you want an indirect hot water tank with it.
Removal of the old boiler, and any permit the job calls for.
qa.a: Prices depend on the job, so none is published; ask Shane for a quote. If you have no heat right now, see the {{emergency-plumbing|emergency page}}.

qa.q: How often should a boiler be serviced?
qa.a: Annual cleaning and service is the usual routine, and it is part of what Shane offers: a clean boiler runs longer and uses less fuel. Book it before the heating season rather than during a cold snap.

send_for_quote: Send with your request: a photo of the boiler and its data label, your fuel (gas or oil), roughly how old it is if you know, the number of heating zones, and any fault code or symptom.
